about.title: About Mframapa AI
about.overview.desc: Mframapa AI estimates daily PM2.5 concentrations across all 54 African nations.
about.overview.problem_desc: Most African cities lack air quality monitors. We fill that gap.
about.how.intro: Leveraging satellite data and machine learning.
about.how.step1.title: Satellites as Sensors
about.how.step1.desc: Using ESA Sentinel-5P and NASA MERRA-2 satellite data.
about.how.step2.title: Ground Calibration
about.how.step2.desc: Model trained on 398 monitoring stations across 29 countries.
about.how.step3.title: Continental Inference
about.how.step3.desc: XGBoost model predicts PM2.5 for any African location.
about.limit.intro: Important limitations to be aware of.
about.limit.cloud_desc: Satellites cannot see through thick clouds.
about.limit.gap_desc: Daily satellite passes may miss short pollution spikes.
about.who.citizens_desc: Check air quality before outdoor activities.
